description: Fork of exp331 (tiny LUT-LM, 32.15 M, val_bpb @ 8K = 1.6915, per-token bw ~228 M bits). Single trade: qkv_tph 8 -> 16 (2x). Per-layer qkv params 442K -> 885K; 6 layers 2.65M -> 5.31M; total 32.15 -> ~34.80 M. Per-layer LUT reads 0.56M -> 0.67M bits (negligible vs vanilla's 28.3M). Step-by-step scaling: after residual_tph 8x (exp330) and out_tph 2x (exp331), test qkv capacity adds further. The goal is to find a LUT-LM with bpb comparable to vanilla bs=16 (1.3882) at lower inference bandwidth (vanilla = 409M bits/token).
